page_title: FUL 1-1 MNU | Fulham v Manchester Utd 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Bryan Mbeumo, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
90+4' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
90+3' The ball goes out for a corner. Fulham can continue in their attacking effort.
90+3' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
90+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fulham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul after Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) hacks down one of his opponents. Fulham get a free kick.
88' The corner is swung in and Harry Maguire (Manchester United) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the left post from close in.
88' Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Ruben Amorim has decided to substitute Luke Shaw and he is replaced by Harry Maguire (Manchester United).
87' Substitution. Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) replaces Leny Yoro.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing.
86' The yellow card goes to Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
83' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
78' The linesman raises his flag. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is adjudged offside.
76' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
74' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Raul Jimenez (Fulham) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
73' 1 - 1 What a goal! Alex Iwobi plays it to Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Altay Bayindir into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
73' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
71' Rodrigo Muniz will be replaced by Raul Jimenez (Fulham).
71' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Joshua King is replaced by Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham).
69' The substitution has been made. Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) has replaced Mason Mount.
69' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) gets to the ball from the resulting corner kick and attempts to curl it past the keeper. His wild shot sails wide of the goal.
68' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
62' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonee Robinson (Fulham) replacing Ryan Sessegnon.
62' Here comes a substitution. Timothy Castagne is given a rest as he is replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
58' 0 - 1 OWN GOAL! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 0:1.
58' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
53' Here is a change. Casemiro is going off and Ruben Amorim gives the last tactical orders to Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United).
52' That will be all from Amad Diallo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Diogo Dalot (Manchester United).
51' Fulham have a corner.
51' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
48' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes a shot which is well saved by the goalkeeper.
48' Manchester Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
45+1' Sander Berge (Fulham) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
45+1' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Kenny Tete (Fulham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
41' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
40' The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
39' Casemiro (Manchester United) obviously dived. Casemiro (Manchester United) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
38' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
37' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
36' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Manchester Utd!
35' Referee Chris Kavanagh makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Manchester Utd. Let’s see what happens!
33' PENALTY APPEAL by Manchester Utd, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
33' Manchester Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
25' Joshua King (Fulham) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
21' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Altay Bayindir intercepts the ball.
20' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
20' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Fulham will take a corner.
17' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the right post from close range.
17' It will be a corner kick for Fulham.

17' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it low towards the middle of the target, but Altay Bayindir pulled off a nice save and to stop the attempt.
17' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
16' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' The game is interrupted as Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is flagged offside.
14' The resulting set piece from Manchester Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

14' A great touch by Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) as he latches on to an excellent cross inside the box. He rips a snap shot close to the right post, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to keep the ball out. World class save! The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester Utd are going to take it.
13' Joshua King (Fulham) gets inside the box and tries to beat Altay Bayindir with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
10' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tested Bernd Leno with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
5' A pass by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
2' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Fulham will take the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh will officiate today.
